title: Example orders dead-letter queue triage

cases.description: the order was already paid before this event was processed
cases.prose: The order entity already shows 'paid', so this dead-lettered 'order.created' event is a known-safe duplicate of an event already applied.
cases.resolution: No action. The order's own state already reflects this event.

cases.description: the order is already cancelled; the dead-lettered event is redundant
cases.prose: The order entity already shows 'cancelled', so this dead-lettered 'order.cancelled' event carries no new information and is safe to drop.
cases.resolution: Remove the message; the order is already in its target state.

followUps: Confirm the order still exists in the source system before reinserting any held message.
